source.title: The Origins of MEV: Systematic Attribution of Arbitrage Opportunity Creation at Scale

interpretation.all_measurements: Reported by the paper's authors, not measured by this guide.
interpretation.percent_units: Reported percentages use a 0-100 scale, not fractions. Differences between percentages would be percentage points.
interpretation.conflict_policy: Preserve conflicting v1 statements with locators. Do not choose a replacement value without additional evidence.

datasets.valuation: Execution-time oracle prices; internal computation in MATIC.
datasets.purpose: Large-scale attribution and protocol distribution analysis.
Method comparison and single-source hypothesis validation.

table_2.accuracy_definition_as_captioned: Triangulated ground truth, or exact Shapley for Shapley methods.
table_2.coverage_definition_as_captioned: Fraction of events with valid attribution.

rows.caveat: Section 5.4 describes 77.2% as agreement with simulation, differing from the caption's reference description.
Section 5.2 reports exact coverage of 12.0%, not 98.1%. Exact Shapley defines part of the reference.
Section 5.2 reports Monte Carlo coverage of 100%, not 98.1%. This attribution score is not a zero-error guarantee for contribution vectors.

validation_reported.correctness_rule: Agreement with at least two sources.
validation_reported.initial_state_agreement: S0 attributions count as matches when methods agree on no in-block source.

single_source_reported.dominance_definition: One transaction contributes more than 70% of total positive Shapley value.
single_source_reported.caveat: 42 plus 33 equals 75, leaving 8 of the reported 83 tied cases unclassified by that paragraph.

monte_carlo_convergence_reported.stabilization_description: Within 5% of asymptotic values after approximately 500 samples.
monte_carlo_convergence_reported.caveat: Illustrated convergence is not a uniform error or ranking guarantee; relative error needs clarification at zero or near-zero values.

protocol_and_concentration_reported.dataset_caveat: Section 5.5 opens with March but labels 220,262 opportunity transactions as February, also repeated by Figure 6. Scope unresolved.
protocol_and_concentration_reported.participation_denominator: Opportunity transactions; multiple AMMs can occur in a transaction, so categories overlap.
protocol_and_concentration_reported.concentration_unit_caveat: Prose describes arbitrageurs/address level; Figure 6 labels transaction percentiles. Do not infer verified entity concentration.
protocol_and_concentration_reported.ratio_scope_caveat: Executed transactions do not count every attempted bid, failed transaction, or off-chain search.

conclusion_only_protocol_value_claim.caveat: No matching protocol-value table is supplied in Section 5.5 or Figure 6; do not equate this with overlapping AMM participation or transaction concentration.

runtime_statements.caveat: The reported aggregate is not implied by the mean and event count. Additional timing scope or overhead is possible but not established by a breakdown in v1.

coverage_partition_as_written.caveat: The described categories do not form an exhaustive partition as written.
